pending_commit.commit_message: util/unpack_ftb.py: a script to convert FTB file into bin file ST firmwares are released in FTB format, which can't be written to flash directly. This python script can convert a file in FTB format into bin file. Currently, we only support FTB files of whiskers touchpad firmware.
